title: Counter
description: The counter terminal at each store: counter orders, money events reaching main, kitchen tickets, the Pi ↔ main sync, terminals and staff, and the day's close. Text panels name the metric each missing panel waits for (HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a).

list.name: store
list.label: Store
list.description: Store slug (tenant) from the Pis' and hubs' resource labels.

panels.title: Pi ↔ main link
panels.description: The Pi's SSE stream to main (sse.connected). Down: counter orders, payments and drawers still work on the Pi and queue for main (sync backlog grows); online orders can't reach the store.

targets.expr: (min by (tenant) (sse_connected{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"})) or (max by (tenant) (max_over_time(sse_connected{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[1d])) * 0)

panels.title: Sync backlog
panels.description: Floor events (counter orders, payments, voids, drawers, Z, journal …) on the Pi not yet acknowledged by main. Growing while the link is up: main is refusing or failing them; see the sync row.

targets.expr: max by (tenant) (floor_sync_backlog{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"})

panels.title: Money events refused
panels.description: Counter money events (order placed / payment / void / change, drawers, Z) that main answered invalid or not_found in the selected range. Anything above 0 = money that may be missing in main: look at the sync refusals log below.

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type=~"order.placed|order.payment|order.void|order.changed|drawer.opened|drawer.movement|drawer.closed|z.report", result=~"invalid|not_found"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Parked on the Pi
panels.description: Events main refused too often or too long, parked on the Pi so the rest of the queue moves on (selected range). Retry them on the Pi page (Overview).

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_sent_total{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", result="parked"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Printers down
panels.description: Printers the Pi can't reach right now (printer.status = 0). A station down: its tickets reroute to another printer with a REROUTED banner. Down = no reachable check for 2 min straight (a short blip doesn't count, like the alert rules).

targets.expr: (count by (tenant) (max_over_time(printer_status{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[2m]) == 0)) or (count by (tenant) (printer_status{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}) * 0)

panels.title: PIN / password lockouts
panels.description: 429 answers from the Pi in the range: a terminal locked after 5 wrong PINs (logins and manager PINs), or a web / link password throttle. Until the Pi sends a PIN metric this is every 429 on the Pi.

targets.expr: sum (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", http_response_status_code="429"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Counter orders (main)
panels.description: Counter orders main stored (order.placed applied) in the range. Exact: a resent event counts once. Lags the Pi while the link is down.

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type="order.placed", result="applied"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Placed on the Pi
panels.description: "Counter order placed" log lines from the Pi in the range (real time, before the sync). Higher than main's number for long = orders stuck on the Pi.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({deployment_environment="$env", service_name="quicc-agent"} |~ `Counter order placed` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Changed after SEND
panels.description: Kitchen changes after SEND that main stored (order.changed applied).

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type="order.changed", result="applied"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Voids
panels.description: Counter orders voided (order.void applied in main). Who voided and why: the Pi's journal (All Checks on the terminal).

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type="order.void", result="applied"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pickups handed over
panels.description: "Pickup handed over" on the Pi (any source) in the range.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({deployment_environment="$env", service_name="quicc-agent"} |~ `Pickup handed over` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Customers saved
panels.description: Customers added or edited at a terminal that main stored (customer.upsert applied).

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type="customer.upsert", result="applied"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Counter events stored by main
panels.description: Counter events main applied per interval, by type (payments include refunds and tips; journal = batches of journal rows).

targets.expr: sum by (type) (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type=~"order.placed|order.payment|order.void|order.changed|journal.entries|customer.upsert|drawer.opened|drawer.movement|drawer.closed|z.report", result="applied"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Placed on the Pi vs stored by main
panels.description: Pi: "Counter order placed" log lines. main: order.placed applied. The lines should overlap; a gap that stays open = counter orders not reaching main.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({deployment_environment="$env", service_name="quicc-agent"} |= `Counter order placed` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}" [$__auto]))
sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type="order.placed", result="applied"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Orders by type and source
panels.description: Waits for a metric or log field the Pi / main don't send yet: HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a has its name, labels and where it is recorded.

options.content: **Needs CM-3 and CM-12** (HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a). Counter orders by type (counter / pickup / delivery) and source (counter, phone, online, website). Today the Pi labels a counter order `web` on `floor.orders.open` and `orders.print.seconds`, so they can't be told apart.

panels.title: Order placement errors
panels.description: Waits for a metric or log field the Pi / main don't send yet: HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a has its name, labels and where it is recorded.

options.content: **Needs CM-1 and CM-3** (HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a). Counter orders the Pi refused (manager_required, cart_invalid, menu_unavailable, over_balance …) by reason. The Pi's HTTP metrics have no `http_route` today, so terminal errors can't be split from the rest.

panels.title: Payments (main)
panels.description: Payment events main stored (order.payment applied): sales, refunds and tips together. Amounts and tenders: see the panels that need CM-11.

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type="order.payment", result="applied"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Drawer opens
panels.description: Drawer sessions counted in (drawer.opened applied in main).

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type="drawer.opened", result="applied"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pay-ins / pay-outs
panels.description: Drawer movements main stored (drawer.movement applied).

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type="drawer.movement", result="applied"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Drawer closes
panels.description: Drawers counted out (drawer.closed applied in main). Over / short amounts: needs CM-14.

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type="drawer.closed", result="applied"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Journal batches
panels.description: journal.entries events main stored: the Pi's audit rows (logins, overrides, comps, discounts, price changes, drawer kicks …) in batches.

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type="journal.entries", result="applied"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Money events refused
panels.description: Same as the top row, split out: money events main answered invalid / not_found.

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type=~"order.placed|order.payment|order.void|order.changed|drawer.opened|drawer.movement|drawer.closed|z.report", result=~"invalid|not_found"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Money events stored by main
panels.description: Payments, voids and drawer events main applied per interval.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type=~"order.payment|order.void|drawer.opened|drawer.movement|drawer.closed", result="applied"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Sales $ and tenders
panels.description: Waits for a metric or log field the Pi / main don't send yet: HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a has its name, labels and where it is recorded.

options.content: **Needs CM-11** (HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a). Counter sales, refunds and tips in dollars by tender (cash, card, comp, …) per store, counted by main when it stores a payment (exactly once).

panels.title: Refunds, voids and comps: who
panels.description: Waits for a metric or log field the Pi / main don't send yet: HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a has its name, labels and where it is recorded.

options.content: **Needs CM-0, CM-13 and CM-5** (HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a). Refunds, voids and comps by staff role, plus a log table naming who did it (staff name, role, amount, approver). Loki gets only the message text today: the Pi's and main's log fields (`staff_id`, `amount_cents` …) never reach Loki.

panels.title: Discounts and price changes over the limit
panels.description: Waits for a metric or log field the Pi / main don't send yet: HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a has its name, labels and where it is recorded.

options.content: **Needs CM-6** (HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a). Manager overrides by action (discount, price change, comp, Employee meal, refund over the limit, pay-out, close batch) and the dollars they moved.

panels.title: Payment errors
panels.description: Waits for a metric or log field the Pi / main don't send yet: HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a has its name, labels and where it is recorded.

options.content: **Needs CM-1 and CM-4** (HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a). Payments the Pi refused or failed by tender and reason (over_balance, refund_too_big, not_payable, manager_required, error).

panels.title: Drawer over / short
panels.description: Waits for a metric or log field the Pi / main don't send yet: HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a has its name, labels and where it is recorded.

options.content: **Needs CM-14** (HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a). Each drawer's over / short at count-out, and the Z report's difference, per store.

panels.title: Printed nowhere
panels.description: Print jobs (any source: counter, online, web) where some ticket printed on no printer at all, even after failover (orders.print.failed). The Pi also sends its own siren Pushover for these.

targets.expr: (sum (increase(orders_print_failed_total{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Counter: no kitchen ticket
panels.description: "Counter order: no kitchen ticket printed" or "Counter change ticket not printed" on the Pi: a counter order or change the kitchen never saw.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({deployment_environment="$env", service_name="quicc-agent"} |~ `Counter order: no kitchen ticket printed|Counter change ticket not printed` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Rerouted
panels.description: Tickets that printed on another printer because their station failed (REROUTED banner), any source.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({deployment_environment="$env", service_name="quicc-agent"} |~ `ticket rerouted` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Kitchen resends
panels.description: Resend to kitchen from a tablet or terminal (orders.reprinted source=kitchen_resend).

targets.expr: (sum (increase(orders_reprinted_total{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", source="kitchen_resend"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Print p95
panels.description: Accept → every ticket written, all sources (a counter order is in `web` today).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase({__name__=~"orders_print_seconds_bucket", service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Print trouble lines
panels.description: "Print trouble on …" lines: one per order with a ticket printed nowhere, rerouted, or an item with no printer.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({deployment_environment="$env", service_name="quicc-agent"} |~ `Print trouble on` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Print failures by reason
panels.description: no_printer / write_error = nothing printed; ticket_failed = some tickets printed nowhere.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (increase(orders_print_failed_total{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Reroutes and counter misses
panels.description: From the Pi's logs: rerouted tickets (any source) and counter orders / changes with no kitchen ticket.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({deployment_environment="$env", service_name="quicc-agent"} |= `ticket rerouted` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}" [$__auto]))

sum (count_over_time({deployment_environment="$env", service_name="quicc-agent"} |~ `Counter order: no kitchen ticket printed|Counter change ticket not printed` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Printers up
panels.description: 1 = reachable, 0 = down, per printer (the Pi probes every 25 s).

targets.expr: max by (printer_name) (printer_status{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"})

panels.title: Counter vs online tickets
panels.description: Waits for a metric or log field the Pi / main don't send yet: HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a has its name, labels and where it is recorded.

options.content: **Needs CM-12 and CM-7** (HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a). Print failures and reroutes split by source (counter / online / web) and by station, as metrics instead of log lines.

panels.title: Sync backlog
panels.description: Floor events waiting on the Pi for main. Grows while the internet is down (expected); should drain in seconds once it's back.

targets.expr: max by (tenant) (floor_sync_backlog{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"})

panels.title: Events sent by the Pi, by result
panels.description: ok = main stored or already had it; rejected = refused (money is kept and retried, the rest dropped); parked = refused for good; error = main unreachable.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (increase(floor_events_sent_total{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Sync delay p95 (counter events)
panels.description: The Pi's event time → stored by main, per counter event type. Seconds normally; minutes after an internet drop.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, type) (rate({__name__=~"floor_sync_latency(_seconds)?_bucket", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type=~"order.placed|order.payment|order.void|order.changed|journal.entries|customer.upsert|drawer.opened|drawer.movement|drawer.closed|z.report"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Counter events by type and result (main)
panels.description: Every counter event main answered in the range. applied = stored; duplicate / stale = already had it (fine); invalid / not_found = refused (money: alert).

targets.expr: sum by (type, result) (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type=~"order.placed|order.payment|order.void|order.changed|journal.entries|customer.upsert|drawer.opened|drawer.movement|drawer.closed|z.report"}[$__range])) > 0

panels.title: Sync refusals
panels.description: The Pi: kept / parked / dropped refusals. main: "floor event refused" (the reason is in main's log fields, not in Loki yet: CM-0).

targets.expr: {deployment_environment="$env", service_name=~"quicc-(agent|main)"} |~ `main refused a floor event|main rejected a floor event|floor event refused` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}"

panels.title: Oldest unsynced money event
panels.description: Waits for a metric or log field the Pi / main don't send yet: HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a has its name, labels and where it is recorded.

options.content: **Needs CM-9** (HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a). How old the oldest money event waiting on the Pi is (seconds), split money / floor, plus the parked count. Today only the backlog count exists; the alert uses "backlog never drained for 15 min" (existing rule) instead.

panels.title: Terminals connected
panels.description: Waits for a metric or log field the Pi / main don't send yet: HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a has its name, labels and where it is recorded.

options.content: **Needs CM-2** (HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a). Each paired terminal's SSE link to the Pi (1 / 0, by terminal name). `floor.tablets.connected` counts Quibase tablets only.

panels.title: PIN / password lockouts
panels.description: 429s from the Pi per interval: a terminal locked after 5 wrong PINs, or a web / link password throttle (no route label yet: CM-1).

targets.expr: sum (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", http_response_status_code="429"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Pi API errors by status
panels.description: Every 4xx / 5xx the Pi answered (terminals, tablets, web page). 401 / 403 include locked terminals and wrong PINs; 409 includes over_balance; 5xx = a Pi bug. Split by route needs CM-1.

targets.expr: sum by (http_response_status_code) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="quicc-agent", deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", http_response_status_code=~"4..|5.."}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Wrong PINs and lockouts per terminal
panels.description: Waits for a metric or log field the Pi / main don't send yet: HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a has its name, labels and where it is recorded.

options.content: **Needs CM-8** (HARDENING-PLAN.md R-1a). Wrong PINs (login, manager check, inline manager PIN) and lockouts per terminal, without the PIN.

panels.title: Z reports (main)
panels.description: Z reports main stored (z.report applied) in the range: one per closed batch.

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type="z.report", result="applied"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Z problems on the Pi
panels.description: "z report: build failed", "z report doesn't balance" or "z report: list pending failed" on the Pi. A Z that failed stays pending and is retried.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({deployment_environment="$env", service_name="quicc-agent"} |~ `z report: build failed|z report doesn't balance|z report: list pending failed` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Batches closed
panels.description: "Batch closed" or "Batch auto-closed" on the Pi.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({deployment_environment="$env", service_name="quicc-agent"} |~ `Batch closed|Batch auto-closed` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Auto-close failures
panels.description: "Batch auto-close failed" on the Pi: the batch is still open.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({deployment_environment="$env", service_name="quicc-agent"} |~ `Batch auto-close failed` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Z refused by main
panels.description: z.report events main answered invalid (kept on the Pi and retried, then parked).

targets.expr: sum (increase(floor_events_received_total{deployment_environment="$env", tenant=~"${store:regex}|", type="z.report", result=~"invalid|not_found"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Driver reports failed
panels.description: "driver reports after close failed" on the Pi: the close's driver reports didn't print.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({deployment_environment="$env", service_name="quicc-agent"} |~ `driver reports after close failed` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Day-close log lines
panels.description: Batch close, Z report and drawer lines from the Pi and main.

targets.expr: {deployment_environment="$env", service_name=~"quicc-(agent|main)"} |~ `(?i)batch (auto-)?clos|z report|drawer closed|driver reports (after close|printed after close)` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}"

panels.title: Counter log lines (Pi and main)
panels.description: Every counter line: orders placed / changed / voided, payments, pickups, drafts, customers, sync, Z. Warnings and errors first in mind: filter with the level column.

targets.expr: {deployment_environment="$env", service_name=~"quicc-(agent|main)"} |~ `(?i)counter|terminal|pickup handed over|draft taken|z report|drawer|floor event|ticket rerouted|print trouble` | tenant="" or tenant=~"${store:regex}"
